biggest_catch: The $50 is simple - the friend just opens a $5 share savings account - but the bonus must stay in the account for 90 days, and the referral email must be included with the new membership application or neither of you gets paid.
catches: Friend must be a new adult member-owner (18+) opening a personal or business share savings account; the referral email must be included with the new membership application.
$5 minimum to open and maintain the share savings account.
The $50 bonus is deposited into the savings account within five business days of account opening and must remain in the account for 90 days.
Referrer must be in good standing to obtain the bonus; officers/directors/volunteers/employees and their immediate families and household members are ineligible.
Only one bonus payment per new member-owner during the promotional period; cannot combine with other share savings offers.
Limited-time offer subject to change at the credit union's discretion; value may be reported to the IRS.

steps: Submit the APGFCU referral form with your friend's information.
Friend opens a new personal or business share savings account ($5 minimum) with your referral email on the application.
A $50 bonus is deposited into your savings account within five business days (it must remain 90 days).
timing: $50 deposited to the referrer's savings account within five business days of the friend's account opening; must remain 90 days.
when_cash_arrives: $50 deposited to your savings account within five business days of your friend's account opening. The friend only opens a $5 share-savings account - no transactions or direct deposit.
maximize: The friend's only requirement is opening a $5 share-savings account - have them apply online the same day.
The referral email must be included with the new membership application; without it, neither of you gets paid.
The $50 must stay in your account 90 days (a hold, not a payout delay).
